data.title: Advanced Matrix Inversion and Determinant Analysis
data.description: Students will rigorously calculate determinants and find inverses for a sequence of increasingly complex square matrices.

challenges.instruction: Calculate the determinant of this 2×2 matrix. Enter the integer value.
challenges.hint: For [[a, b], [c, d]], det = ad − bc.

challenges.instruction: Find the inverse of this 2×2 matrix. Enter each entry of A⁻¹.
challenges.hint: For [[a, b], [c, d]] with det = ad − bc, A⁻¹ = (1/det) · [[d, −b], [−c, a]].

data.educationalContext: Mastery of matrix inverses and determinants is foundational for solving multivariable linear systems, transforming geometric spaces, and advancing in linear algebra.
